title: An essay finds published packages and installs what it needs (2026-11-04)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content: Lets start with the basics. The real next step is allowing for the installation of packages. An essay should be able to find a list of published packages and install what is needed.

sections.name: source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-04; recorded verbatim. Given as the answer to two asks on muDemocracy.org#431: whether problem should require persona and scale, and whether essay should carry a claim type.
